title: Naramata Bench 5 Winery Tour
includes: Hotel / accommodation pick up and drop off included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Welcome to your Naramata Bench Wine tour! Nestled among the foothills of the Okanagan mountains, the Naramata Bench offers unique terroir, endless sunshine, handcrafted wines and an intimate experience within one of Canada’s most iconic wine regions. This action packed 6 hour wine experience offers access to the best of the Okanagan wine culture! White or Red, Vivid’s Naramata Bench wine tours offer something for all wine lovers. This tour visits 5 wineries.

Located only a short drive from the city of Penticton, B.C., this full day (6 hours) Naramata Bench Wine Tour offers access to Naramata’s most sought after wineries and includes a lunch stop with reservations at a winery bistro.
